name: Honduras (1839–1866)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of blue, white and blue.
history: After Honduras left the Federal Republic of Central America in 1839 it kept the plain blue-white-blue triband of the federation as its flag. On 16 February 1866 President José María Medina's Legislative Decree No. 7 added five blue stars for the five original provinces of Central America, creating the flag still in use.
